semiconductor_relevance: High — Chin Kong Graphic Corp. specializes in optoelectronic components and thermal conductive materials, which are critical in semiconductor applications.
summary: Chin Kong Graphic Corp. manufactures optoelectronic components and innovative non-silicone thermal conductive materials, addressing the needs of high-power electronics and automotive applications. With a focus on material technology upgrades, the company provides solutions that enhance thermal management and reliability in electronic assemblies.
